additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431718-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004076] Charging Issue CRM:02699000147
additional_info.body:
Hello Mishra,
I write you because you opened the ticket and Joaquin is out today, he supported me for sets the router and we thought that was a problem in the customer network.  Yesterday the router lost again the settings, and the customer check their network and it is working properly. I tried with another router too.
The problem in the charger (Charger 1) is customer’s router XF4 is not connecting to the customer network. I need support for set it by wan wired.
There is another charger (Charger 2)on site and it is working well connected to the customer networks.
Network customer parameters are:
Charger IP 192.168.10.222
Mask: 255.255.255.0
Gateway 192.168.10.1
For working charger (Charger 2)is the same settings with the IP 192.168.10.221
TEST done.
We can do ping to the charger 2 but not to the charger 1.
Disconnect charger 1 and sets the IP 192.168.10.222 to the charger 2 in order to check that network policy is not limiting the traffic for this IP. Charger 2 with the IP of charger 1 works. Is not an IP problem.
Disconnect charger 2 and sets the IP 192.168.10.221 to the charger 1. Charger 1 with the IP of charger 2 does not work. Is not an IP problem.
Did a configuration backup from router XF4 on charger 2 and was copied in the router XF4 on charger 1 (Changing the IP) not works too.
Sometimes when sets network parameters the router shows “network device is not present”
We replace the router with another one and did settings with the companion tool but still having the same problems.
Could you, or anyone, assist me today?
THX
With best regards,
